integrity: The exact formula is proved structurally and separately checked by exhaustive refinement over all path-plus-cycle rival decompositions through order 30. The computation supports but is not used as a substitute for the proof.
limitations: Restricted to finite simple undirected paths in two-variable first-order logic with counting. The priority check is targeted rather than exhaustive; an unindexed thesis or folklore occurrence remains possible.
title: Exact two-variable counting depth of finite paths
